top_news.title: GPT-5.6 Sol Pricing Cut by 50%
top_news.dek: OpenRouter has implemented a 50% price reduction for API access to the GPT-5.6 Sol model.
top_news.brief: The price cut is part of a broader series of model discounts currently available on the OpenRouter platform. Developers can access the updated pricing structure via the provider's model dashboard.

top_news.title: Qwen 3.8 27B scores 52 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index
top_news.dek: The Qwen 3.8 27B model has achieved a score of 52 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index.
top_news.brief: This performance matches GPT-5.6 Luna and places the 27B parameter model within one point of significantly larger or specialized models like GLM-5.2 and DeepSeek V4 Pro, highlighting the efficiency of the Qwen 3.8 architecture.
top_news.image_alt: Bar chart comparing model benchmark scores

top_news.title: Forward Pass Domain Adaptation (Without Cross-Layer Backpropagation)
top_news.dek: Forward-Pass-Only (FPO) training enables efficient LLM adaptation by eliminating cross-layer backpropagation.
top_news.brief: FPO training achieves 2.7–3.2x the throughput of standard fine-tuning with 40% less peak memory. By avoiding the backward pass through the model body, it maintains performance on off-domain benchmarks while significantly reducing computational overhead, offering a more stable alternative to full-network fine-tuning.
top_news.image_alt: Diagram showing forward-only data flow in a neural network

top_news.title: DOJ probes Andreessen Horowitz over partners sitting on competing AI boards
top_news.dek: The DOJ is investigating Andreessen Horowitz for potential antitrust violations regarding board seats at competing AI firms.
top_news.brief: The US Department of Justice is probing whether Andreessen Horowitz partners holding board seats at competing companies, such as Databricks and Fivetran, violates antitrust regulations. The investigation highlights growing regulatory scrutiny over venture capital influence in the AI sector.
top_news.image_alt: US Department of Justice building exterior

top_news.title: Cartesia Ships Sonic-3.6: A Streaming TTS Model That Now Leads Both Artificial Analysis Speech Arenas
top_news.dek: Cartesia's new Sonic-3.6 model uses state space architecture to top Artificial Analysis speech leaderboards.
top_news.brief: Sonic-3.6, a streaming text-to-speech model built on state space models rather than transformers, now ranks first on both Artificial Analysis speech leaderboards. The model achieves sub-90ms time-to-first-audio, demonstrating significant improvements in synthesis speed and naturalness.
top_news.image_alt: Graph showing Sonic-3.6 performance on speech leaderboards

primary.title: Learning Discrete Riemannian Metrics for Physical Fields with Cochain-Frame Equivarianc
primary.summary: Physical fields on meshes require a separation between topology and geometry: conservation laws are topological and should be exact, while geometry, material response, and anisotropic coupling must be learned from data.
